assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness that are concerning for potential arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period.
The service is Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229).
The ordered diagnostic procedure directly addresses the clinical concern of potential arrhythmia.
The service is medically appropriate given the diagnosis of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency with symptoms requiring rhythm correlation.
This service aligns with the documented clinical indication.
This service is consistent with the diagnosis codes provided on the claim.
